seo__search_description: Free community laundry service at 1 Dale Street, Fairfield. Open Tuesday to Thursday, 12pm–2:30pm. Last entry 1pm.
hero__intro: A free community laundry service for people doing it tough.
intro_details__text: The Oakdene Laundrette provides free laundry facilities for people experiencing hardship. Whether it's a temporary situation or ongoing difficulty, everyone deserves clean clothes.
laundrette_images__image_alt: Washing machines inside the Oakdene Laundrette
how_it_works__text: The same eligibility applies as the Oakdene Kitchen. Bring a current Centrelink Income Statement and photo ID. Your statement must show income under **$1,200 per fortnight**.
group_bookings__text: We offer group laundry bookings outside public hours, available Tuesday to Thursday, for non-profits supporting homelessness, shelters, and group homes.
group_bookings__text_2: Must be booked by a support worker who attends in person
cta__heading: Ready to visit or need more information?
data__steps: Check in with staff or security on arrival
Receive a washing tablet and number tag matching your machine
Load your clothes, place the tablet in the drum and press Start
When the wash finishes, move items to the dryer
Stay nearby while cycles run — visit Oakdene Kitchen while you wait
Return your number tag when finished
